semiconductor_relevance: High — TMH is involved in the sale and refurbishment of semiconductor equipment and components, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor supply chain.
summary: TMH specializes in the sale of semiconductor equipment, including used equipment and refurbishment services for various components. They also operate an e-commerce platform, LAYLA-EC, facilitating global procurement of semiconductor-related products.
capabilities: Refurbishment of ESCs from Level 0 to Level 4
Sales of consumable parts such as Si, quartz, and ceramics
Abatement equipment using plasma technology for dry pumps
CVD technology for high selectivity and anti-reflective coatings

regional_presence.Japan: TMH has a track record of purchasing and selling over 500 units based on performance in both domestic and overseas markets in Japan.
